turns.text: Hey! Actually, I just got back because I went to my sister Ana's wedding in San Antonio. It happened today, we did a small Tuesday morning ceremony and it was absolutely beautiful.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, wow, today! Congratulations to Ana and your whole family. How was the ceremony in San Antonio? Did everything go smoothly?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was perfect, really intimate and sweet. I'm pretty exhausted from the travel and the emotional high, though. Today I'm just keeping it super casual and wearing an oversized hoodie while I catch up on some work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: An oversized hoodie sounds like the perfect uniform for a post-wedding recovery day. Are you working from your place with Sam today, or heading into the office?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just working from our apartment today. I needed a bit of a gentle start, so I made myself a matcha latte this morning to get focused.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A matcha latte sounds like a great choice, especially since you've been mindful of cutting back on caffeine after your check-up. Did it give you the right amount of energy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, it was just the right amount of kick without making me jittery. For lunch, I ended up making a quick deli sandwich with some smoked provolone and avocado.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That deli sandwich sounds delicious and easy to throw together. Did you get to play any guitar or do any climbing lately, or has it been all wedding prep?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mostly wedding prep, honestly! I haven't touched my guitar in a few days, but I'm hoping to get back to climbing sometime later this week.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense, weddings are a lot of work even as a guest. I hope you get to unwind with some climbing soon. Have a relaxing rest of your Tuesday!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm definitely going to take it easy tonight. Talk to you later!
